title: Temporary and permanent Lahaina wildfire debris disposal sites
summary: Permanent hauling of Lahaina wildfire debris out of West Maui is set to begin in June, with about 50 truck round trips a day. Hauling will run from sunup to sundown, including during West Maui canoe regattas. All the debris, whether owners opted in or out of the government program, will go to the permanent site at the Central Maui Landfill, with a temporary site planned next to it.
